name: getTrainingCalendarCourseDetails
description: Retrieves scheduled training course entries from the Training Calendar, including course name, schedule dates, seat availability, application cut-off date, and approval status. Supports filtering by a specific course, by approval status (Approved/Pending), and by a specific date - covering "view available trainings" and "view trainings on a specific date".

basic.name: getTrainingCalendarCourseDetails
basic.description: Retrieves scheduled training course entries from the Training Calendar, including course name, schedule dates, seat availability, application cut-off date, and approval status. Supports filtering by a specific course, by approval status (Approved/Pending), and by a specific date - covering "view available trainings" and "view trainings on a specific date".

args.name: courseCode
args.description: The course code to filter the training calendar by (e.g. `"000070"`). Use `"-1"` to retrieve all courses.

args.name: status
args.description: Approval status filter for the schedules

args.name: date
args.description: Specific date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. When provided, only training schedules occurring on that date are returned.
